items.name: Acolyte's Daggers
items.desc: Missing Description

items.name: Alien Idol
items.desc: Reveal the secrets of the beacons

items.name: Alluring Mushroom
items.desc: A glistening mushroom unlike any other. Looking upon it makes the mouth water and mind alight with strange dreams.
items.effect: Its effects are unknown.

items.name: Basement Key
items.desc: Etched in fine lettering, the inscription reads: "If there were no locks, there would be no thieves."
items.effect: Opens the basement to the strange house.

items.name: Blackmarrow Key
items.desc: Inside the Mether’s bones, lies her most potent gift, the Blackmarrow. And yet when released from her heavenly form, it’s crudely called Gloom.
items.effect: Opens a locked treasure in the Marrow Keep.

items.name: Bloodseed
items.desc: Its flesh-like sheaf protects a nutrient rich yolk of sorts.

items.name: Brass Knuckles
items.desc: Missing Description

items.name: Burnt Effigy
items.desc: The ashen figure’s name is lost. All that is remembered is that he must suffer for his treachery.

items.name: Cage Key
items.desc: It's scratched and bent, but sturdy.
items.effect: Key that opens the hunter's cage.

items.name: Central Shaft Lever
items.desc: A sturdy lever without ornamentation. And yet there are subtle hints that its craftsman sought beauty in its singular design. Initials are proudly etched in its iron.
items.effect: Opens the Central Shaft Gate in the mines.

items.name: Chapel Key
items.desc: In a tiny scrawl, an inscription has been carved into this key: “Our fair lady is as strong as the oxen, wise as the trees, and brilliant as the sunrise.”
items.effect: Unlocks the Chapel doors outside the Mushroom Village.

items.name: Chest Key
items.desc: A sturdy key.
items.effect: Unlocks a particular chest.

items.name: Citadel Gate Lever
items.desc: Etched above every gate is a single phrase. "Pain is purpose." It is written in the old tongue, but some still remember these words. Most wish they could forget them.
items.effect: Unlocks the main gate to the Citadel of Penance.

items.name: Coin
items.desc: Missing Flavour Text

items.name: Coin of Mammon
items.desc: Once a symbol of unimaginable riches, but it still remains valuable to collectors.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>500</> coin.

items.name: Common Moonshine
items.desc: A slurry of spirits and Tar that is sure to embolden even the most cowardly, at least for a time.

items.name: Crypt Key
items.desc: A discarded memento, forsaken by a disciple who found himself drawn to a new sense of purpose.
items.effect: Opens a locked door within a dungeon.

items.name: Damp Key
items.desc: Slightly damp and sticky, but otherwise non-descript.
items.effect: Opens the Sinking Village's secret.

items.name: Depleted Gland
items.desc: A limp, shrunken gland. Its flesh flakes away like drifting ash. Drained, it can expel little more than fumes. If inhaled, these vapors may briefly befuddle the senses, conjuring up images of fire and blood that vanish as quickly as they appear.
items.effect: A remnant of the Revered. It may still be of use.

items.name: Devout’s Chalice
items.desc: There’s still a trace of dried Nektar in its hollow.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>{Cost}</> coin.

items.name: Dorsalite
items.desc: A remnant of the chitinous carapace that allowed the Blessed Mether to descend upon what would become Fainweald.
items.effect: Consumed by the Tarforge to improve weaponry.

items.name: Endless Core
items.desc: The device hums with promise. With it one may toil without end, but for what purpose? Finality offers freedom, while infinity marches on.
items.effect: Feed to the Tarforge to remove the level cap on weapon and sidearm upgrades.

items.name: Equilibrium Pulse
items.desc: Missing Flavour Text
items.effect: Activate to restore minor health while also rekindling a portion of <Resolve>Resolve</>.

items.name: Etching Needles
items.desc: Slender needles, meticulously crafted to pierce far more than stone.
items.effect: Bring to Franz to discover its true purpose.

items.name: Ethereal Diapason
items.desc: Missing Description

items.name: Extracted Specimen
items.desc: A small shred of flesh extracted by the Biosampler. The rare few who’ve studied this mechanism agree it appears to “ingest” the specimen. But what exactly happens to the extract is a source of great disagreement. Perhaps it's best not to know.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>{Cost}</> coin.

items.name: Faded Gland
items.desc: A dim, lifeless gland. Its obsidian flesh pales, the pulse inside either dead or imperceptible. Inside its twin hearts, the Nektar has been emptied, but the venom remains. Those who seek infinity will only find its end within.
items.effect: A remnant of the Revered. It may still be of use.

items.name: Feeding Room Key
items.desc: The key is covered in jagged, little scratches.
items.effect: Unlocks the door at the bottom of the well.

items.name: Foundry Stone
items.desc: Ash gently wafts from this smoldering relic.
items.effect: Bring to Franz to discover its true purpose.

items.name: Futilium
items.desc: The pursuit of purpose ends with life.

items.name: Galvanic Shard
items.desc: Of unknown origin or purpose, this piece releases an arcing jolt when jostled.

items.name: Glimpse
items.desc: A ponderous whirl of color, light, and lost reveries.
items.effect: Awakens a Shell's true purpose.

items.name: Gloom
items.desc: Missing Flavour Text

items.name: Gloom Resin
items.desc: A powerful Gloom residue used to claim Shells.

items.name: Gloombound Flame
items.desc: The flame burns impossibly. Shadows appear to grow and stretch in its cold brilliance. Within one’s grasp, it begins to feel as if a hopeless, endless night will threaten even the brightest day.
items.effect: A unique flame fit only for the lantern atop the Marrow Keep.

items.name: Gloomstone
items.desc: A powerful Gloom residue used to forge Weapons.

items.name: Gragu Keepsake
items.desc: Missing Description

items.name: Grimorium Obscurum
items.desc: At first glance, the words inside appear no more than a series of scratches and strikes without reason or purpose. And yet the closer one looks, the more a pattern seems to emerge.
items.effect: Gives access to a secret.

items.name: Grisha Remnant
items.desc: The spirits of the Grisha are said to live on long after death. Those that slay them honorably may be granted a remnant of their strength. They may even find themselves fighting alongside their spectral forms in times of great need.

items.name: Heart of Vatra
items.desc: Within the petrified flesh, a slow steady pulse can still be felt. Though few remember the name of Vatra, those who do wait patiently for her blessings. For the stone endures in silence and even when it breaks, it will one day be reformed.
items.effect: The heart of a long dead Revered.

items.name: Hideout Cage Key
items.desc: The weathered wrought iron is scratched ornamentally. This key has been rarely used.
items.effect: Unlocks the makeshift hideout cell.

items.name: Immaculate Crown
items.desc: The crown of Winterglass remains perfectly preserved. While worn, one feels a faint memory stir. A whispered message, "Change is the enemy. It is the small death that leads to the annihilation of infinity."
items.effect: Unlocks secrets within the ice.

items.name: Inner Purge
items.desc: Missing Flavour Text
items.effect: Activate to restore health and cleanse all conditions. Comes with reduced charges.

items.name: Justicar's Mask
items.desc: Missing Description

items.name: Knight Lady Keepsake
items.desc: Missing Description

items.name: Laterite
items.desc: It’s said these pieces of the Blessed Mether rain down from the heavens and fall at the feet of her favorites.
items.effect: Consumed by the Tarforge to improve weaponry.

items.desc: A rudimentary cloth map. It seems to point to a specific location.
items.effect: Marks the location of this Weapon on your Map

items.name: Makeshift Projectile
items.desc: The weapons of war remind us that it is far easier to destroy than create.
items.effect: Ammunition for a great siege weapon.

items.name: Mango
items.desc: This remarkable fruit is a favorite among rogues.

items.effect: Reveals a new portion of Ruk's Map.

items.name: Mark Of The East
items.desc: Unlocks corrupted stash

items.name: Mark Of The South
items.desc: Unlocks corrupted stash

items.name: Mark Of The West
items.desc: Unlocks corrupted stash

items.name: Marsh Pearl
items.desc: Though little more than a wet, stinking clump, it’s treasured by those who revere the Great Frógga.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>2,000</> coin.

items.name: Martyr's Ash
items.desc: The remains of frozen martyrs were once considered relics, but now only dust is left.

items.name: Mether's Breath
items.desc: A wisp of Mether's breath which escaped the Gloom Siphon.
items.effect:
Allows quick travel between beacons and can be used to cleanse certain corruption walls.
Can also be use to return to Marrow Keep, at the cost of all held Gloom.

items.name: Mether's Flesh
items.desc: The Mether’s Flesh is a remarkable discovery. For centuries, the kings and queens of Mammon sought it at all costs. The nobility feasted upon the sacred flesh believing it would bestow upon them miraculous gifts. And it did, in a sense, until there was none left.
items.effect: The Nightfish dreams of the Mether’s Flesh.

items.name: Mether's Pulse
items.desc: A reverberation from the Underglade that mends wounds and knits flesh anew. There is no question that the Harbinger has been bred for a task no mortal could undertake.
items.effect: Activate to restore a portion of health immediately.

items.name: Monolith Fragment
items.desc: A faded chunk of etched obsidianite. Supposedly, both past and future were writ upon it. In time though, study and inquiry gave way to worship. Discrepancies were overlooked or even  dismissed. In the end, it only offered another false hope.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>5,000</> coin.

items.name: Moonlight Sonata
items.desc: A ghost in the sky, a silver river.
items.effect: Unlocks the secrets of the strange house.

items.name: Muradean Actuator
items.desc: A strange, unrusting mechanism, crafted for an unknown machine.
items.effect: Bring to Franz to discover its true purpose.

items.name: Muradean Tome
items.desc: What could be more valuable than the secrets of Muraden?
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>1,500</> coin.

items.name: Obsidian Lathe
items.desc: Though the obsidian has faded, the device remains more than functional.
items.effect: Bring to Franz to discover its true purpose.

items.name: Offspring Trophy
items.desc: Many would be proud to claim such a trophy. But not all revile these creatures. Some believe they're the children of the most holy union, the converging of the Blessed Mether and Sacred Passenger.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>5,000</> coin.

items.name: Orrem’s Head
items.desc: Within ossinite and quenched iron, lies the mark of its creator. A single word etched meticulously in the language of Mammon. “Endure” it reads. And so the golem did, but his creator never expected another creature might inhabit and exploit his masterwork.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>5,000</> coin.

items.name: Ossinite
items.desc: A fragment of the Blessed Mether’s bones. Few pieces remain that don’t belong to Her temples.
items.effect: Consumed by the Tarforge to improve weaponry.

items.name: Ova
items.desc: Missing Flavour Text

items.name: Paradoxical Scripture
items.desc: The Children of Infinity embraced paradox. Through death they were reborn. They arose as Sesters and brethers unbound from their flesh. Time itself has no hold on them. And in their freedom they only grew more heedless.

items.name: Poisoned Dagger
items.desc: Though the Brosca are nearly extinct, even a small secretion from their glands remains deadly.
items.effect: Only a knowledgeable inhabitant of these lands will know how to concoct a cure.

items.name: Resolve Conduit
items.desc: Missing Flavour Text
items.effect: Channel to restore health over time by consuming <Resolve>Resolve</>. Interrupting the channel ends the effect immediately.

items.name: Revered Gland
items.desc: The remains of a sacred organ once extracted from a god.
items.effect: Consume at a Beacon to increase your ability to use Mether's Pulse.

items.name: Revered Heart
items.desc: A reverberation from the Underglade that mends wounds and knits flesh anew. There is no question that the Harbinger has been bred for a task no mortal could undertake.

items.name: Ruk's Map
items.desc: The lines of this map spread and shift as if guided by an unseen hand. Perhaps it is the same hand that blessed loyal Harros with renewed life?
items.effect: Ruk’s Map reveals lost relics, shells, and ova.

items.name: Sage's Gate Lever
items.desc: An inscription, carved into the lever reads: "Trust is the currency of fools."
items.effect: Opens the Sage's Gate.

items.name: Seedbearer’s Scripture
items.desc: Though the author’s name is lost, his words live on. He who held the seeds of infinity in his palm, made a promise. If he could not end what he started, he would find another way. The scripture pledges to cleanse the Revered, but such claims remain untested.

items.name: Sester's Censer
items.desc: This censer is not unlike those once favored by the Children of Infinity. If one peers inside, they may glimpse figures gliding like apparitions through the smoke.
items.effect: Bring to Genessa to unlock its secrets.

items.name: Sester’s Crest
items.desc: In death, the sester withers and vanishes, but her crest remains. Heavy and crystalline, its form resembles a large Tarstone. Is this the fate of all Children of Infinity? Or did the Black Needle have some untold influence over her?
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>3,000</> coin.

items.name: Sheephead Totem
items.desc: When the sheep first returned to Fainweald many rejoiced. They gave thanks to the herders who shared their bounty. They hardly even noticed when their neighbors began to disappear. Why worry when your belly is full?

items.name: Sliver of the Unbidden
items.desc: The severed remains of the Unbidden. At first, he was not unlike the Harbinger. And yet, as he matured into a new form, he succumbed to that which he was meant to destroy. The Foul Passenger breached his flesh, reshaping it for his own purposes. What was left of the original child? Who can say?
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>10,000</> coin.

items.name: Special Moonshine
items.desc: This is no brigand-swill. The bottle is unopened, wrapped carefully in sackcloth by its maker. Perhaps it's meant for more than mere merriment?
items.effect: A truly special bottle of moonshine.

items.name: Starlight Sonata
items.desc: Burning bright, yet distant and small
items.effect: Unlocks the secrets of the strange house.

items.name: Strange Village Key
items.desc: A simple key, nearly indistinguishable from any other.
items.effect: Unlocks the village's secret.

items.name: Study of Franz
items.desc: The sketch bears the roughness of an early work, but the passion is evident.
items.effect: One in a series of portraits.

items.name: Study of Harbinger
items.desc: A remarkable depiction of the Harbinger’s unadorned flesh.
items.effect: One in a series of portraits.

items.name: Study of Merrick
items.desc: Precise linework and subtle shading reveal a master’s hand at work upon the page.
items.effect: One in a series of portraits.

items.name: Study of Milos
items.desc: An ambitious study. Clearly, the subject inspired the artist to capture a great swath of details.
items.effect: One in a series of portraits.

items.name: Study of Zhirelle
items.desc: A bold rendering, full of style and movement, but lacking in restraint.
items.effect: One in a series of portraits.

items.name: Sunlight Sonata
items.desc: Ringer of life, bringer of flame
items.effect: Unlocks the secrets of the strange house.

items.name: Synaptic Vessel
items.desc: A strange, root-like growth that radiates warmth as it pulses with an unseen heartbeat.
items.effect: Consume at Beacons to improve your Mether's Pulse efficiency.

items.name: Tarcore
items.desc: Though discarded and broken, this is no meager bauble. A metallurgist's gift remains buried in its remains.
items.effect: Used to temper Tarstones at the Tarforge.

items.name: Tarspore
items.desc: Though poisonous, eating this fungus is a right of passage in many villages.

items.name: Tempered Iron Key
items.desc: An inscription reads: "When neighbors look upon each other with suspicion, the keymaker smiles."
items.effect: Unlocks a door somewhere.

items.name: Thawed Gland
items.desc: A dull, empty gland. Though once hard as stone, it's now slick and supple, dripping a cloudy liquid. Those that dare consume it are left deeply disappointed. There is no salvation to be found, only opaque memories from a distant past.
items.effect: A remnant of the Revered. It may still be of use.

items.name: Thoracium
items.desc: Prized for its proximity to the Blessed Mether’s womb, these calcified chunks are said to pulse with life.
items.effect: Consumed by the Tarforge to improve weaponry.

items.name: Thorn Keepsake
items.desc: Missing Description

items.name: Tooth of Nochte
items.desc: A canine of remarkable size—often found in alleyways and odd corners of the former kingdom.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>750</> coin.

items.name: Tresure Room Key
items.desc: Missing Flavour Text
items.effect: Unlocks Tresure Room

items.name: Trollweed
items.desc: A rare plant of dubious use. It’s often confused for a far more potent variety.

items.name: Undersap
items.desc: Undersap description.

items.name: Unremarkable Key
items.desc: Slightly damp and sticky, but otherwise non-descript.
items.effect: A key to an unknown lock.

items.name: Ventrium
items.desc: A calcified fragment often mistaken for the Blessed Mether’s bones. Some believe it’s a remnant of her sacred flesh.
items.effect: Consumed by the Tarforge to improve weaponry.

items.name: Voltaic Essence
items.desc: A strange, throbbing sensation emanates from within like distant thunder. Some objects even seem to draw the energy, but only with careful focus.
items.effect: Use to power long forgotten mechanisms.

items.name: Vratko's Self-Study
items.desc: A crude, but earnest drawing.
items.effect: One in a series of portraits.

items.name: Weapon Fragment
items.desc: A fragment of a lost weapon.

items.name: Weltcap
items.desc: Often near battlefields, these mushrooms thrive where blood has spilled.

items.name: Winterglass Gem
items.desc: Highly sought by those hoping to find a frozen remnant of a Martyr preserved inside.
items.effect: Can be traded for <Bold>1,000</> coin.

abilities.name: Executioner
abilities.desc: Eredrim executes enemies on low health and gains <Slaughterer>Slaughterer</> stacks by performing a <Bold>Riposte</>. Stacks are lost upon resting or being severed.

abilities.name: Shoulder Bash
abilities.desc: Eredrim lunges with his shoulder, slamming into enemies and dealing <Break>Break Damage</>.

shells.name: Genessa
shells.ability: Nothing is so broken it can’t be made whole again.

abilities.name: Duality
abilities.desc: When <Bold>Genessa's</> health is depleted, she becomes <Bold>Stray</> instead of being severed from the <Bold>Harbinger</>.

abilities.name: Faithful Doubles
abilities.desc: Genessa summons <Bold>Faithful Doubles</> which perform a <Bold>Weapon</> attack and then vanish.

abilities.name: Staggering Blow
abilities.desc: Gragu charges a devastating punch that makes the victim to heavy stagger. The longer the charge the higher the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Revered Heart
abilities.desc: A Revered heart used by Gragu to restore a portion of Health. It is possible to replenish its power by slaying foes.

shells.name: Harros
shells.ability: A man is more than mere flesh and bone.

abilities.name: Stone Stun
abilities.desc: Harros petrifies nearby enemies, leaving them unable to act. While hardened, they take no damage but suffer <Break>Break Damage</> instead.

shells.name: Proxima
shells.ability: Purpose gives the soul its shape.

abilities.name: Grafted Armor
abilities.desc: Proxima has a base <Bold>15%</> chance to mitigate melee or ranged damage. Mitigated damage is reduced by a base <Bold>50%</> and prevents stagger.

abilities.name: Biosampler
abilities.desc: Proxima fires a hook from her left arm, pulling enemies or herself into range before striking with a follow-up attack that inflicts <Lightning>Lightning</>.

shells.name: Sariel
shells.ability: That path to perfection is paved with blood.

abilities.name: Exodus of Thorns
abilities.desc: Sariel expels parasitic thorns that hunt nearby enemies, inflicting <Curse>Curse</> stacks. Each activation inflicts <Pain>Pain</> on Sariel.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.desc:
When Sariel has no <Pain>Pain</> <Bold>50%</> of any incoming damage becomes <Pain>Pain</>.
When Sariel is at max <Pain>Pain</>, Sariel dodges faster.

shells.name: Smert
shells.ability: Truth is the final revelation before death.

abilities.name: Miracle
abilities.desc: Smert sacrifices half of his <Bold>Health</> to halt time and enter a <Bold>Fight Stance</>. Unarmed attacks inflict <Chaos>Chaos</>, detonating when time resumes. Extend Miracle into <Bold>Overtime</> by sacrificing additional <Health>Health</>.

abilities.name: Deadly Revelation
abilities.desc: At <Bold>10%</> health or lower Smert has <Faith>Faith</>.

shells.name: Tiel
shells.ability: Once you have nothing, you’re free to take everything.

abilities.name: Shadow Dash
abilities.desc: Dashing just before getting struck grants Tiel <Shadow>Shadow</> and inflicts <Poise>Stagger Damage</>.

abilities.name: Lingering Shadow
abilities.desc: Tiel gains <Shadow>Shadow</> and prepares to perform a <Bold>Shadow Strike</> with his dagger.

shells.name: Lazlo
shells.ability: Justice is not given, it is exacted.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.desc: Lazlo heats his armor, unleashing a <Bold>Shockwave</>. Repeated use causes <Bold>Overheat</>, triggering a stronger shockwave that inflicts <Burn>Burn</> stacks but temporarily disables his armor.

abilities.name: Fortified Plate
abilities.desc: Lazlo has a base <Bold>10%</> damage reduction as long as his armor is on.

tarstones.name: Wounding Stone
tarstones.desc: Melee attacks inflict <Perforation>Perforation</>

sidearms.name: Ballistazooka
sidearms.desc: Heavy and unwieldy, scholars argue if the weapon was ever used in battle or just executions in Muraden.

sidearms.name: Caged Hystrix
sidearms.desc: The contraption pierces the creature trapped inside, prompting a violent and often useful reaction.

sidearms.name: Cursed Child
sidearms.desc: Stranded between life and death, this child yearns to be held and will desperately protect its caretaker.

sidearms.name: Forgotten Crossbow
sidearms.desc: Traded to a merchant by a desperate addict, this crossbow is surprisingly well-calibrated.

sidearms.name: Naylshotte
sidearms.desc: Accursed arms birthed by a malevolent forge rumored to have a will of its own.

sidearms.name: Salvaged Trebuchaxe
sidearms.desc: Surprisingly sophisticated for a device that utilizes axes as projectiles.

sidearms.name: Triarch Repeater
sidearms.desc: Carved bone and grafted metal reinforcements hint at this strange weapon's otherworldly origins.

sidearms.name: Troubadour's Lute
sidearms.desc: A relic of a simpler time. Favored by wanderers, this lute soothes man and beast alike
sidearms.effect: A special sidearm that inflicts <Confusion>Confusion</> when used in combat

weapons.name: Axatana
weapons.desc: Forged by an unrepentant smith, this exquisite weapon once bore the name “Dream Thresher.”

weapons.name: Axe & Dagger
weapons.desc: An unusual pairing of a simple thieve's tool and a vicious axe from the northern lands.

weapons.name: Black Needle
weapons.desc: Stolen from the Twiceborn, this spear enables the bearer to reach further and more quickly than seems physically plausible.

weapons.name: Clockwork Scythe
weapons.desc: The ambitious instrument of a madman or a genius, perhaps he was in fact both.

weapons.name: Great Martyr's Blade
weapons.desc: The devout weapon of the First Martyr Tarsus, reforged after his final sacrifice.

weapons.name: Obsidian Hammer
weapons.desc: A brutalist chunk of obsidianite, profaned by bloodshed beyond the Seat of Infinity.

weapons.name: The Iconoclast
weapons.desc: Exceptionally light for a two-hander, it was once held by a seedbearer of great renown

weapons.name: Veteran's Battle Axe
weapons.desc: This solid steel axe is rumored to have been quenched in the blood of the Revered.
